title: Bunkie
subtitle: Brand Identity & Design System
overview: The objective was to create a cohesive, scalable brand identity and design system from the ground up, translating brand values into a unified visual language and ensuring consistency across digital and print through accessible guidelines.
problem: Without a unified identity, cross-platform assets suffer from inconsistent typography, mismatched palettes and fragmented messaging. The challenges were a distinct logo and mark, an accessible color and type system, and clear guidelines for design and development teams.
solution: A complete brand identity system built on a distinct logo suite, an accessible palette with WCAG AA contrast, a robust typography hierarchy and structured guidelines. A shared component library and single source of truth keep implementation consistent across digital and print.

features.title: Logo Suite
features.description: Primary logo, secondary mark, app icon, and clear-space specifications for adaptability across light/dark themes and varying screen sizes.

features.title: Color Palette
features.description: Primary brand colors, functional UI colors, and background tones supporting visual hierarchy and WCAG AA contrast compliance.

features.title: Typography System
features.description: Display/heading scale, body text styles, and button/label styles ensuring consistent vertical rhythm and clear visual hierarchy.

features.title: Brand Rules
features.description: Incorrect usage examples, photographic guidelines, and tone of voice for long-term consistency across internal teams and vendors.

results.description: Streamlined the design-to-development workflow by centralizing all brand assets
Visual alignment across social media assets, digital product UI, and collateral
Built to expand alongside future product lines and marketing campaigns

sections.title: Executive Summary
sections.content:
Role: Brand Designer & UI/UX Specialist

Deliverables: Brand Strategy, Visual Identity System, Brand Guidelines Document, Component Library

Tools: Figma, Adobe Illustrator

sections.title: Process & Approach
sections.content:
Step 1: Research & Discovery

- Brand audit: Analysed market positioning, audience and competitors to define visual tone and personality.
- Moodboarding: Explored directions focused on modern aesthetics, legibility and geometric balance.

Step 2: Visual Identity

- Logo & mark: Iterated logo formats, iconography and clear-space rules for screens and print.
- Color system: Defined primary, secondary and neutral palettes with WCAG contrast.
- Typography: Selected versatile type pairs for headlines, body and UI.

Step 3: Guidelines & Systems

Built a Brand Guidelines document covering logo usage, color codes (HEX, RGB, CMYK), type scales, icon sets and imagery do's and don'ts.

sections.title: App Screens
sections.content: A curated selection of the Bunkie app screens, covering onboarding and sign in, listing discovery, saved and requested listings, listing creation, identity and selfie verification, and profile management.

sections.title: Impact & Results
sections.content:
- Efficiency: a single source of truth for all brand assets streamlined the design-to-development workflow.
- Consistency: 100% visual alignment across social assets, product UI and collateral.
- Scalability: a flexible system built to expand with future product lines and campaigns.
